thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — hosted-api us-west-2: request queue length spiked to ~12,400, p99 latency > 30s, GPUs at 100%. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/incidents/1764012345 :rotating_light:

sre-aly: oncall here, looking now. any immediate customer reports?

ashwin: seeing a large burst from tenant=marketing-campaign-svc hitting long-context endpoints (seq len ~8192). lots of KV reads, huge memory pressure on GPUs.

elaine: autoscaler logs show repeated failures to create instances: cloud error quotaExceeded for GPU quota in us-west-2. attempted to spin more, blocked.

raj: I'm on infra quota channel with cloud-ops to request temporary bump. filing support ticket: https://cloud/req/98765

ashwin: routing shows ~40% of traffic to model-prod-longcontext; can we fallback low-priority traffic to a smaller model?

sre-aly: action plan: 1) enable route-level fallback for non-logged-in/free-tier traffic to redwood-lite-8q, 2) manual scale a dedicated pool for high-priority tenants, 3) apply tenant rate-limits for marketing-campaign-svc. I'm going to enact 1 + 2 now.

elaine: note — autoscaler minReplica was 60 and maxReplica 120. cloud quota prevented >60. that explains stuck behavior.

deploy-bot: started manual pool-provision job: add 20 GPUs to us-west-2-dedicated-pool (job id: pool-add-1764012345). ETA ~6m.

ashwin: applying temporary route override:
```
POST /api/v1/routes/override
{ "match": "tenant:free OR route:low-priority", "fallback_model": "redwood-lite-8q" }
```

support-jamie: sending status update to customers impacted by higher p99/timeout risk. adding note to status.redwood.ai: "We are mitigating a traffic spike affecting some requests in US-West. No data loss. Temporary fallbacks and rate limits applied."

raj: cloud-ops confirmed quota bump request in progress but uncertain timing. they suggested proxying some traffic to eu-west as a last resort.

sre-aly: deploy-bot job green — dedicated pool added 20 GPUs. beginning reroute of high-priority traffic to dedicated pool.

deploy-bot: routing change applied: tag high-priority -> us-west-2-dedicated-pool.

ashwin: p95 dropped from ~6.2s to 820ms after fallback + dedicated pool. queue length at ~1.2k and draining. p99 still elevated ~3.5s for a small tail.

elaine: still seeing ~2 tenants with repeated timeouts — their calls are 2x memory than others. recommend immediate tenant-level rate-limit to 20r/s and contact their eng lead.

support-jamie: reached out to marketing-campaign-svc slack and emailed account owner. they confirmed a misconfigured client that retried aggressively.

ashwin: applied tenant cap via console: `tenants/marketing-campaign-svc/quota -> 20r/s (temp)`

sre-aly: good. queue draining to ~300. continuing to monitor. starting handoff notes for night SRE — will leave this on pager for observation.

elaine: saved autoscaler logs + errors to /incidents/1764012345/logs and flagged repeated `quotaExceeded` responses. create follow-up to tighten autoscaler retry/backoff to avoid deadlock.

raj: will follow up with cloud-ops on permanent quota lift or multi-region spill. filing infra ticket INFRA-1764.

sre-aly: mitigation effective. p95 ~450ms, p99 ~1.4s, queue ~120. removing critical pager. leaving monitoring alert at warning. handoff to night SRE @ 1764015900. Postmortem placeholder: PMTO-176401 — suspected root cause: unanticipated long-context burst + autoscaler quota floor preventing scale out.

ashwin: quick mitigation notes added to runbook: short-circuit long-context >4096 for free tier, ensure autoscaler respects cloud quota feedback and fails open to fallback models.

support-jamie: sent follow-up to affected customers with mitigation summary and ETA for full postmortem.

sre-aly: thanks team. will prep a concise timeline and actions for postmortem. handing off to night shift. :white_check_mark:
